instruction_note: This fragment declares NO task_instruction and NO task_instruction_template: the system message of every contact is the draw's own rendered proposer or placebo instruction (rails.proposer.render_proposer_instruction / render_placebo_instruction), resolved at flight time by core.flight.runtime._default_construction_material from the committed roster, the registry rows, the incumbent state and the carrier's construction rows. It is never written to a receipt: a proposer prompt carries construction query text and gold calls.
roster_note: construction_proposer_roster_receipt, its split identity hash and construction_target_tools are declared by the PER-ROUND experiment fragment scripts/run_evolution_round.py emits, because the roster is per round and core.config.compose refuses the same key from two fragments.
scoring_note: Only the 'cost' scorer. A proposer response is an ARTIFACT -- a JSON object of tool descriptions -- not an answer to a scored row, so the carrier's own scorers would be scoring the wrong thing and would need gold these construction samples have no business resolving. The candidates are produced afterwards, model-free, by rails.evolution.harvest_proposer_responses over the sealed manifest.
